set.body:
191 fmri_lm() call sites: tests 154, vignettes 21, roxygen @examples 11,
R/ internal wrappers 3, bench 1, README 1.

Cheaper than the formal count suggests - the list route already dominates:
  AR:     ar_options 61  vs  cor_*/ar_p/ar1_exact_first 12
  robust: robust_options 12  vs  robust_* 5

Only 17 sites use any shorthand. Vignettes and @examples become the documentation
of the new style, so migrate those deliberately rather than mechanically.
set.title: Migrate in-repo callers to control=/compute=
